# AUGMANITAI Portal

> Central landing page of the AUGMANITAI Research Programme. Connected corpora describing the phenomenology of human-AI interaction, browsable several ways.

## About

This page is part of the **AUGMANITAI Research Programme** by **Andreas Ehstand** — Independent Researcher, Human-AI Interaction (Germany). Descriptive phenomenology of patterns observed when humans interact with AI systems.

Content is AI-assisted and human-curated. Attribution required (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), non-commercial, no derivatives. Per EU AI Act Article 50 (from 2026-08-02), AI-assisted content is disclosed as such.
